headline: Tarik Skubal agrees to record 450 million dollar 9 year contract with New York Mets
label: NEWS
caption:
Baseball star Tarik Skubal is heading to New York with a historic deal. ⚾

According to an AP source, Tarik Skubal has agreed to a record 450 million dollar, 9 year contract with the New York Mets.

The massive agreement makes waves across Major League Baseball as one of the largest financial commitments in sports history.
